mapper.select: SELECT id, code, name, parent_id, manager_user_id, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM tb_department WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT id, code, name, parent_id, manager_user_id, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM tb_department WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT id, code, name, parent_id, manager_user_id, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM tb_department WHERE code = #{code} AND deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_department (code, name, parent_id, manager_user_id, created_at, deleted) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{parentId}, #{managerUserId}, SYSUTCDATETIME(), 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_department SET name = #{name}, parent_id = #{parentId}, manager_user_id = #{managerUserId}, updated_at = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE id = #{id}
